name: starlight-product-studios
description: Five governed product studios for publishing, templates, software, media, and Arcanea experiences.

interface.longDescription: Choose a specialist studio, create a complete product artifact and prepare its release evidence. Covers publishing, editable templates, software, media and world experiences, coordinated by a product director. Uses the tools available in your host. This skills-only package does not create a hosted service, run background agents, take payments or publish without authorization.
defaultPrompt: Route this product through the right specialist studio.
Build a release-ready product and its channel package.
Audit this product against studio quality gates.
